subject: Co-sell demo scheduling — Sweeney Health (APAC)
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@orbital-systems.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Tariq Nassar <tariq@cloudforge.io>, apac-ops@orbital-systems.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 02:14:00 +0900
Subject: Co-sell demo request: Sweeney Health (APAC)

Hi Dylan,

Quick intro — I’m Samira (partnerships, Orbital Systems). We’ve got an inbound from Sweeney Health (APAC — Singapore HQ) looking for a short co-sell demo next week to evaluate Redwood inference for a pilot (privacy-sensitive workload, expected P0 latency needs). They asked for a 45–60 minute session with 20–25 attendees: product leads, security, and procurement.

Key asks from Sweeney:
- 20min runtime demo showing low-latency multimodal routing + cost controls
- 15–20min SI deep-dive on deployment options (VPC/private) and E2E security posture
- Short Q&A and next steps (mutual action plan)

Attached: Sweeney_ROI_and_attendees.xlsx with rough attendee list and time preferences. Can Redwood lead the runtime demo and take recording ownership? Orbital (Tariq) will cover infra and procurement signals.

Preferred windows (local SGT):
- Tue 2026-09-08 15:00–16:15
- Wed 2026-09-09 20:00–21:15 (evening friendly for US folks)
- Fri 2026-09-11 10:00–11:15

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should be on the invite? Also note they require a short pre-demo security checklist to be sent 48h prior.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Partnerships, Orbital Systems
samira@orbital-systems.com

--- Attachment: Sweeney_ROI_and_attendees.xlsx (excel) ---

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@orbital-systems.com>, Tariq Nassar <tariq@cloudforge.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 07:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo request: Sweeney Health (APAC)

Samira / Tariq — thanks for the details and the attendee sheet. Looping in Kim (security & partner MAM) and Vanessa (partnership ops) to confirm ops/SLAs.

High level from Redwood: we’re happy to lead the runtime demo. Proposed run split (45–60m total):
- 0–5m: quick intros & goals
- 5–25m: Redwood runtime demo (low-latency routing, batching knobs, live token cost breakdown) -> Dylan to lead
- 25–45m: Orbital / SI deep-dive on VPC/on-prem deployment + security controls -> Tariq to lead
- 45–60m: Q&A + mutual action plan / next steps

A few operational asks so we can lock a slot:
- Which of the three windows is highest priority for Sweeney?
- Are there any embargo/recording restrictions? Redwood usually requests recording for internal follow-up; we can flag parts to be excluded if needed.
- Kim — can you confirm a 48h pre-demo checklist (security artifacts) we can send?

We have the following staff options for the Redwood side: me (demo), Kim for security Q&A, Vanessa for follow-up & MAP. Vivek can drop in for infra questions if needed.

I’ll hold the Tue 15:00 SGT slot tentatively for 24 hours while we confirm. If we can get the preferred window, I’ll send the calendar invite + placeholder DocuSign link for the MAP.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com

Thanks for the fast turnaround. If you can send the calendar invite + short MAP draft today we’ll send a confirmation to the Sweeney stakeholders.

Best,
